name: K'
source: Kidnapped at a young age and trained to be a weapon, the day came where K' had his DNA fused with Kusanagi Kyo's. This gave him the ability to manipulate fire. K' is a very gruff kinda guy. He's a bit anti-social, rarely ever letting his guard down around people. Arrogant and rude, he often calls people names. He is often called immature and whiny by other character.
